notes.title: Small Update for Feb 7
notes.notes:
- (2) New hidden achievements were added.
- Updated some achievement descriptions.
- Some ingredient models got revamped which should prevent some collision bugs.
- Added BREAD to the game.

notes.title: Small bugfixes
notes.notes:
A few bugfixes which will make the playing experience a tad better!

- Vampire can't grab you through the walls anymore.
- You can now get the achievements for the different endings.
- Fixed a small sound bug.
